title: Hearty Harmonious Brazilian Orange Pasta
description: A pungent and flaky Brazilian dish featuring orange, pasta water emulsion, and gluten free friendly ingredients, this recipe is perfect for a energizing dinner

ingredients.name: gluten free pasta
ingredients.notes: such as brown rice pasta or quinoa pasta

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the gluten free pasta according to package instructions
In a blender or food processor, combine orange juice, olive oil, garlic, and ginger, and blend until smooth
In a large skillet, heat the blended orange mixture over medium heat
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss to combine with the orange sauce
Season with salt and black pepper to taste
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and top with grated parmesan cheese and chopped fresh cilantro
Garnish with additional cilantro if desired
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days
